Reload 150-300 ms after Recommend (during the star animation), level_01 and level_02: stars saved correctly (3 for a perfect pick)
Reload with the 'new friend' unlock card open (level_01)
Reload after a fail (level_01, Satay Spot): 0 stars stored, level_02 stays locked, no stars gained
Leaving the level_20 Outcome before pressing Continue, and leaving mid-Ending (part 1) and on part 2
Leaving the Outcome early with 'Next level' before the unlock card appears (level_02)
Backspace from mid-chat to the map and back into the level
Two tabs in one browser context: play level_01 in tab A, look at the map and Friends in tab B, reload B; Reset progress in A while B is open

bugs.title: Ending is lost for good if the player reloads or leaves mid-ending
bugs.where: Ending, after a perfect level_20 pick
steps: Have levels 01-19 cleared, then pick Breakwater on level_20 (or open ?scene=Outcome&level=level_20 on the dev server)
Press Continue → on the Outcome screen; the Ending group chat starts
About 4 s in (mid part 1), reload the page or close the tab
Start again, open the map, replay level_20 and pick Breakwater again
bugs.expected: A refresh or crash mid-ending should not count as having seen it: the Ending plays again (or Continue → comes back) until it has actually been watched or skipped with Esc
bugs.actual: lets-eat-ending-seen-v1 is set to 1 the moment the Ending scene is created (EndingScene.create calls markEndingSeen first). After the reload the level_20 Outcome shows only 'Back to levels'; the Ending can never be seen again without Reset progress, which wipes all stars. There is no replay prompt yet (by design), so the player has no way back to it
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2: once via the normal Continue route, once via the dev shortcut; the flag is set at the start of part 1 both times)

setup.settings: defaults; progress for level_01-19 written to localStorage

bugs.title: 'New friend' card is lost forever if the player leaves the Outcome within 1.4 s
bugs.where: Outcome, level_01 and level_02 (any level that introduces a friend)
steps: Fresh save with level_01 cleared and lets-eat-friends-announced-v1 = [liam, cyrus]
Play level_02 and recommend Taco Town (perfect)
Within about 1 s of the Outcome screen appearing, either reload the page or click 'Next level →'
Replay level_02 and pick Taco Town again
bugs.expected: Maya's 'A new friend has joined!' card shows the first time the player clears a level with her, so it should still show on the next clear if it never appeared
bugs.actual: OutcomeScene.newPageNote calls markAnnounced(friends) at once, but the card only appears after UNLOCK_DELAY_MS (1400 ms). Leaving earlier saves maya as announced and the card never appears, on this visit or any replay. Same when reloading with Liam's card open on level_01: Cyrus's queued card ('NEXT FRIEND →') is lost too
bugs.frequency: every time (3 of 3: reload at 150 ms on level_01, reload at 300 ms on level_02, Next level click at 0.8 s on level_02)

bugs.title: Scrapbook page unlocked in the chat is never announced if the player reloads or goes back to the map first
bugs.where: Chat then Outcome, level_01 (satay_incident); any level with a callback line
steps: Fresh save (How to play and chapter 1 card already seen)
Open level_01 and let the chat run until Liam's line 'right right. the satay incident. never again'
Either reload the page, or press Backspace to go back to the map (the map now reads SCRAPBOOK 1/5)
Open level_01 again, finish the chat, pick Noodle Nook
bugs.expected: The Outcome shows the 'NEW SCRAPBOOK PAGE · The Satay Incident' note and the 'New scrapbook page!' card, as it does when the level is played in one go (r2_outcome.jpg)
bugs.actual: The page is saved to lets-eat-scrapbook-v1 as soon as the line is read, but the list of pages to announce lives only in the registry (newPages:level_01), which a reload wipes and ChatScene.init resets on re-entry. unlockPage then returns false, so the Outcome shows only the friend card and no page note. The player is never told about the page
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2: one reload, one Backspace)

bugs.title: Chapter card and How to play are marked seen when they open, so a reload while they are up skips them for good
bugs.where: Chat, level_01 (chapter 1 card, How to play); any first level of a chapter
steps: Fresh save. Title → Enter → Enter to open level_01
While the 'CHAPTER 1 · CAMPUS QUARTER' card is up, reload the page
Open level_01 again: the chapter card is gone and How to play shows
While How to play (step 1 of 3) is up, reload again and reopen level_01
bugs.expected: A card counts as seen once the player closes it, so a reload while it is up shows it again
bugs.actual: showChapterIntro and showHowToPlay call markSeen() before drawing. After the first reload the chapter card never shows again; after the second, How to play never shows again (lets-eat-how-to-play-v1 = 1). A new player who refreshes on that screen misses the tutorial (it is still reachable from Options, and the chapter card from the chapter heading)
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2 for each card)

not_bugs: Every reload goes back to the Title screen, never into a half-finished level; stars, pages and venues are intact and none are gained without a win
Stars are saved the moment the Outcome opens, so a reload during the star animation keeps the earned stars; a fail stores 0 and does not unlock the next level
A scrapbook page unlocking on reading the line, even after a fail, matches the bible (Scrapbook > Unlock)
Starred Notebook lines are cleared when re-entering a level's chat (ChatScene resets pins), so losing them on reload matches that design
The chosen district is kept only in memory (registry); after a reload the map opens on the newest chapter. It is remembered after visiting a level, as the checklist asks
Browser Back leaves the game entirely (there are no in-game history entries); nothing breaks
Two tabs: the second tab's map is stale until reloaded, then correct; no data is overwritten between tabs; Reset progress in one tab does not touch the other tab's settings
localStorage.clear() then reload starts clean with no errors; the chapter card and How to play show again
5 minutes idle on the Chat: no freeze, the music moves on to the next track, never two tracks at once; three reloads in a row also give one track
Outcome sounds: one result sound and one star sound per star (3 for a perfect pick)
All Options settings survive a reload; music off stays silent; Reset progress keeps settings and clears stars, pages, friends, venues and the ending flag
Leaving the level_20 Outcome before Continue → leaves the Ending unseen; it comes back on the next perfect level_20 pick (plays after a perfect level_20 pick, by design)
feedback: Everything that celebrates (friend cards, the scrapbook note, the ending) is saved as 'done' before the player actually sees it, so a player who refreshes quietly misses the game's best moments.
